title: Shadows of the giants: who loses the winter sun to Britain's towers?
excerpt: On the shortest day a shadow in London is 3.7 times the height of what casts it. I traced the winter sun through eight UK city centres: ordinary streets take most of it, but at Canary Wharf the towers take 0.76 hours from every square metre.
seo_description: Winter shadows in eight UK city centres: the Shard's noon shadow on 21 December is 1,146 m; which streets lose their sun to towers?
